selection.method: First listed source recording from each native weapon event; original event variant lists retained for audit. Existing runtime sound-marker phases preserved.

limitations: The pinned CS2 depot contains some recordings retained from CS:GO; these are selected by current CS2 soundevents, not relabeled historical source downloads.
One native variation per event; random selection, per-event sound-operator gain/pitch/distance layers and Source 2 mixer are not reproduced.
Mono Opus conversion and browser HRTF/room processing preserve existing browser mixing, not exact native output.

The existing six callback phases approximate complex reloads (e.g. belt covers and dual magazines). XM1014 Grab supplies its action marker; CZ uses the native event-mapped shared P250 actions with its own clip-in.
